src='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in g:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    marker = 2
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marked = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == marker]
    objects = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (background, marker)]
    if not marked or not objects:
        return g
    horizontal_bar = len({r for r, c in marked}) == 1
    if horizontal_bar:
        bar = marked[0][0]
        dr = 1 if bar > max(r for r, c in objects) else -1
        edge = min(r for r, c in objects) if dr > 0 else max(r for r, c in objects)
        destinations = [(r + dr, c, g[r][c]) for r, c in objects]
        if any(not (0 <= rr < h) or g[rr][c] == marker for rr, c, _ in destinations):
            return g
        for r, c in objects:
            g[r][c] = background
        for rr, c, value in destinations:
            g[rr][c] = value
        g[edge] = [8] * w
    else:
        bar = marked[0][1]
        dc = 1 if bar > max(c for r, c in objects) else -1
        edge = min(c for r, c in objects) if dc > 0 else max(c for r, c in objects)
        destinations = [(r, c + dc, g[r][c]) for r, c in objects]
        if any(not (0 <= cc < w) or g[r][cc] == marker for r, cc, _ in destinations):
            return g
        for r, c in objects:
            g[r][c] = background
        for r, cc, value in destinations:
            g[r][cc] = value
        for r in range(h):
            g[r][edge] = 8
    return g
'''

src='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in g:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marker = 2
    marked = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == marker]
    objects = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (background, marker)]
    if not marked or not objects:
        return g
    horizontal_bar = len({r for r, c in marked}) == 1
    if horizontal_bar:
        bar = marked[0][0]
        top = min(r for r, c in objects)
        bottom = max(r for r, c in objects)
        dr = 1 if bar > bottom else -1
        distance = bar - bottom - 1 if dr > 0 else top - bar - 1
        shifted = [(r + dr * distance, c, g[r][c]) for r, c in objects]
        for r, c in objects:
            g[r][c] = background
        for r, c, value in shifted:
            g[r][c] = value
        trail = min(r for r, c, _ in shifted) - 1 if dr > 0 else max(r for r, c, _ in shifted) + 1
        if 0 <= trail < h:
            g[trail] = [8] * w
    else:
        bar = marked[0][1]
        left = min(c for r, c in objects)
        right = max(c for r, c in objects)
        dc = 1 if bar > right else -1
        distance = bar - right - 1 if dc > 0 else left - bar - 1
        shifted = [(r, c + dc * distance, g[r][c]) for r, c in objects]
        for r, c in objects:
            g[r][c] = background
        for r, c, value in shifted:
            g[r][c] = value
        trail = min(c for r, c, _ in shifted) - 1 if dc > 0 else max(c for r, c, _ in shifted) + 1
        if 0 <= trail < w:
            for r in range(h):
                g[r][trail] = 8
    return g
'''
